cost_link.explanation: A change of d in success rate changes expected gross return per trade by d x (mean return of successes - mean return of failures). The success-rate change whose return gain just pays one round trip is cost / spread.

6_brier.note: The test-base-rate constant uses the test outcome rate (an oracle no model could know in advance); the validation-base-rate constant is the fair no-skill comparator.

8_incomplete_labels.handling: triple_barrier(): if the data simply ends before T+10 the label is NaN (stocks that stop trading get 0 instead, D-017). assign_split() puts an event in a split only if label_end is known and <= split end, and tier1() keeps only label_10.notna(); so these events are excluded from every hypothesis test, model and backtest - not imputed, not counted as failures.

9a_composite.formula: Score = 0.30*CQ + 0.25*DZ + 0.25*PA + 0.20*VA, each component a train-split z clipped to [-3,3], missing -> 0; CQ = z(mean(-z bbw_pct252, -z atr_ratio, +z nr7_count10, -z range_contraction)); DZ = z(deliv_z20); PA = z(mean(z price_oi_align, (fii_fut_stk_cot-50)/28.87)); VA = z(vol_z). Tradeable if Score >= 1.0.

9b_h3_formula.formula: asymmetry(G) = mean(MFE_10 over G) / mean(|MAE_10| over G); statistic = asymmetry(regime) - asymmetry(rest); regime = fii_flow20 < 0 AND dii_flow20 > 0 (20-day change in cumulative FII / DII cash flow); p from a calendar-month block bootstrap (1,000 draws); expected sign +.
9b_h3_formula.MFE_MAE: MFE_10 = max high(T+1..T+10)/entry - 1; MAE_10 = min low(T+1..T+10)/entry - 1; entry = open(T+1)

9c_165_vs_157.rule: executor.run_backtest: max 20 concurrent equal-weight positions, one position per stock at a time, entry at T+1 open, exit at the triple-barrier exit; signals with no free slot are dropped (not queued).
